title: pcapng: make pcapng_read_systemd_journal_export_block() less different.
description:
Instead of passing it a pcapng_t * that it doesn't use, pass it a
section_info_t * that ot doesn't use.

This means pcapng_read_block() doesn't use *its* pcapng_t * argument, so
don't pass it one.
